brainstormingReferences.title: References
brainstormingReferences.help: Keep the design context you explored. Linking does not change the original content.
brainstormingReferences.overviewHelp: This compares names, descriptions and overview metadata only—not Sheet fields, Flow nodes, Scene geometry or asset files. A reference is not a full copy or a playable version.
brainstormingReferences.historyHelp: Up to 49 consulted contexts are retained without removing earlier ones. These are not versions of the original content.
brainstormingReferences.emptyHelp: Link existing content to give this exploration a concrete starting point.
brainstormingReferences.noResults: No available content matches this search.
brainstormingReferences.unavailableHelp: This content was removed or is no longer accessible. The reference is kept without exposing its details.
brainstormingReferences.refreshHelp: Save the current context and keep the previous one in history. This does not change the original content.
brainstormingReferences.removeHelp: Only the reference is removed. The original content is not changed.
brainstormingReferences.readOnly: You can view references but cannot change them.
brainstormingReferences.archived: Reopen this session to change its references.
brainstormingReferences.error: The reference could not be updated. Check current access and try again.
brainstormingReferences.historyLimit: This reference already retains 49 contexts. You can inspect them or unlink it, but cannot save more versions.
brainstormingReferences.referenceLimit: This session or idea already has 100 references. Unlink one before adding another.
brainstormingReferences.alreadyLinked: This content is already linked for that purpose.
brainstormingReferences.offline: Connection interrupted. Check the references before retrying.
brainstormingReferences.stale: This reference changed elsewhere. Review the latest context and try again.
